q2_gaps: a proper-noun premodifier followed by a CAPITALIZED common-noun head ('the Cauldron Hall Warden'): the proper-noun-premodifier rule (never fuses, head never joins the Name string, linked by opaque Possession) and the mechanical capitalized-run name rule (the capitalized run exceeds the bare class word, so it becomes a Name-only individual with an ordinary type atom, cf. 'the Grand Assembly' / 'Upper Calderwick') give different parses, and the instruction set does not say which governs
notes: The parse takes the Northgate-spokesman route (warden witness + Possession + Name/type on 'Cauldron Hall'), whose structure it matches exactly, but every example of that rule has a lowercase head noun, leaving the capitalized 'Warden' unlegislated. Speech-verb 'report' with an entity object correctly keeps Agent (not Experiencer), and 'the Council' correctly gets no Name atom.
